facts.fact: The World Bank team said in a January 2026 blog that complaint-handling mechanisms of the Merankabandi social safety net project were strengthened and field complaints are integrated into its CORE-MIS system, with dashboards tracking progress and complaints; no number of complaints is given.

The World Bank team said in January 2026 that Merankabandi's CORE-MIS, hosted by the government, is interconnected with several payment service providers for payment processing and reconciliation and delivered emergency transfers to over 30,000 beneficiaries.

BDI.note: No payments law or rules stated.

facts.fact: The World Bank team said in January 2026 that the CORE-MIS system of the Merankabandi project is interconnected with several payment service providers, and that field data from KoboToolbox flows into it automatically.

The World Bank team said in January 2026 that Merankabandi runs on CORE-MIS, an open-source management information system after migrating over one million beneficiary records, hosted by the government at SETIC, covering over 315,000 households.
The World Bank team said in January 2026 that CORE-MIS manages disbursements and is interconnected with several payment service providers for payment processing and reconciliation.

BDI.note: The Unified Social Registry is only envisaged; no procurement, pilot or population stated.
